title: Top-level pages
description: Every top-level page under site/, in nav menu order. Posts are found automatically and do not go here. {name} is filled in from data/site.json.

nav.description: Stamps the shared nav into the page.

menu.description: Shows a link to the page in the site nav.

noindex.description: Adds a noindex tag, so search engines skip the page.

pdf.description: Names a PDF that scripts/render_pdf.py prints from this page when the site publishes. The page links to it. It is never committed.

absolute.description: Writes root-relative links (/styles/site.css) in the nav and footer, for a page served at any depth, such as 404.html.
